auth.label: Public API Key
auth.description: More Trees public API key. Find it under Settings > Account Settings at https://dashboard.moretrees.eco.

extraFields.label: Public Validation Key
extraFields.description: More Trees public validation key used when listing planting projects.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Get account identity, planting credit balance, and forest identifiers for the connected More Trees account.

inputSchema.description: The request for the connected More Trees account.

outputSchema.description: The More Trees account information returned for the connected account.

actions.name: get_forest
actions.description: Get More Trees forest branding and cumulative planting and carbon statistics.

forestSlugOrAccountCode.description: The forest slug or account code to inspect. Defaults to the connected account code.

inputSchema.description: The request for a More Trees forest.

anyOf.description: The forest logo URL when configured.

logo_url.description: The forest logo URL when configured.

anyOf.description: The forest brand color when configured.

brand_color.description: The forest brand color when configured.

trees_planted.description: The number of trees planted by the forest.

trees_gifted.description: The number of trees gifted by the forest.

trees_received.description: The number of trees received by the forest.

co2_captured.description: The amount of carbon dioxide captured for the forest.

projects_supported.description: The number of planting projects supported by the forest.

totals.description: The cumulative planting and carbon statistics for a More Trees forest.

outputSchema.description: The More Trees forest branding and cumulative impact information.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: List active More Trees planting projects and the tree species available within each project.

inputSchema.description: The request for active More Trees planting projects.

id.description: The project identifier used by planting requests.

country.description: The country where the project operates.

default.description: Whether this is the default planting project.

anyOf.description: The project image URL when available.

project_image.description: The project image URL when available.

id.description: The tree species identifier used by planting requests.

tonnes_c02.description: The tonnes of carbon dioxide captured by one tree.

credits_required.description: The number of credits required to plant one tree.

default.description: Whether this is the default tree for the project.

anyOf.description: The tree image URL when available.

tree_image.description: The tree image URL when available.

items.description: A tree species available within a More Trees planting project.

trees.description: The tree species available for this project.

items.description: An active More Trees planting project and its available tree species.

outputSchema.description: The active planting projects returned by More Trees.

actions.name: plant_trees
actions.description: Plant trees for the connected More Trees account or gift trees to recipients, with optional non-persistent test mode.

plantForOthers.description: Whether to gift trees to recipients instead of planting for the connected account.

test.description: Whether to evaluate the request without persisting it or spending planting credits. More Trees defaults this to false.

quantity.description: The number of trees to plant for the connected account. Required when plantForOthers is false.

projectId.description: The planting project identifier. More Trees selects the default project when omitted.

treeId.description: The tree species identifier. More Trees selects the default tree when omitted.

accountCode.description: The recipient's More Trees account code. Provide exactly one of accountCode or email.

email.description: The recipient's email address. Provide exactly one of email or accountCode.

quantity.description: The number of trees to gift to this recipient.

items.description: A recipient who should receive one or more gifted trees.

recipients.description: The recipients who should receive gifted trees. Required when plantForOthers is true.

inputSchema.description: The More Trees request for planting trees for the connected account or gifting trees to recipients.

test.description: Whether More Trees evaluated the request in non-persistent test mode.

plant_for_others.description: Whether the request planted trees for recipients instead of the connected account.

credits_used.description: The number of planting credits used or evaluated.

credits_remaining.description: The number of planting credits remaining.

project_id.description: The planting project selected by More Trees.

tree_id.description: The tree species selected by More Trees.

account_code.description: The recipient's More Trees account code.

account_name.description: The recipient's More Trees account name.

quantity.description: The number of trees planted for the recipient.

items.description: A recipient confirmed by the More Trees planting response.

recipients.description: The recipients confirmed for a gifted-tree request.

outputSchema.description: The More Trees planting result and remaining credit balance.
